purpose: Separate shelf freshness from checkout readiness. A product may be fresh enough to display when price, stock and destination shipping are freshly verified, while still requiring a new quote at checkout.
truth_precedence: For CJ stock and destination shipping, hunt-cj-quote is canonical over inventory fields embedded in product detail.
Product detail remains canonical for current product/variant identity and retail-price/profit-gate data.
A stale catalog stock_quantity never overrides a fresh variant quote.
recheck_before_checkout is shelf-eligible but never checkout-ready by itself.
fresh_shelf_requirements: market_eligibility_status is recheck_before_checkout, eligible or allowed
fresh price observation with retail_verified=true and profit_gate_status=PASS
fresh stock observation from canonical quote with stock_verified=true and stock_available=true
fresh shipping observation for destination country with shipping_verified=true and numeric shipping amount
all three observation classes are within freshness window
checkout_live_requirements: market_eligibility_status is eligible/allowed OR checkout policy explicitly accepts recheck after a new quote
a new checkout-time stock+shipping quote succeeds for the chosen exact variant and destination
selected variant is the variant represented by the quote

observed_endpoint_disagreement.conclusion: Do not use product-detail embedded inventory as final CJ stock truth.

hard_rules: Never refresh a timestamp without a successful external evidence call.
Never mark checkout-ready from shelf freshness alone.
Never change market_eligibility_status from this refresh lane.
Never overwrite retail price from a supplier cost field.
Never promote a stale catalog stock count over a fresh variant quote.
Never write a stock/shipping observation when the corresponding CJ verification flag is false.
A product refresh failure leaves the previous state stale/recheck; it does not fabricate availability.
